home.thesis: AI-era enterprise .NET systems you can prove.
home.subtitle: Architecture, workflow orchestration and test strategy for platforms that carry real load — and AI that works inside the guardrails, not around them: spec-driven generation, deterministic gates, evidence over promises.
home.signature: A golden path, layer by layer — <goldpath>goldpath</goldpath> scaffolds it, <specdrift>specdrift</specdrift> keeps it honest.
home.stackDescription: Diagram: a golden path as five stacked layers — spec, contracts, code, verification and runtime — with a signal flowing from the spec down to production.
layers: What must be true — one manifest is the single source of truth.
How services speak — OpenAPI and AsyncAPI, versioned with the code.
What runs — generated on the golden path, not hand-rolled.
The proof — specdrift checks that the code still matches the spec.
What production does — traced end to end with OpenTelemetry.

about.title: Hi, I'm Ömer.
about.metaDescription: Ömer Çelik is a software architect and lead .NET engineer building AI-era enterprise systems you can prove — orchestration, integration and quality on platforms that carry real load.
body: I'm a software architect and lead .NET engineer. For the last decade I've built the systems large organisations run on — orchestration, integration, the platforms underneath — mostly in the telco and banking domains, where a wrong answer is expensive.

What I care about is simple to say and hard to do: a system should be able to prove it does what its specification says. Contracts first, tests as evidence, and now AI working inside those guardrails rather than around them.
This site is where I write down what I've learned, show it running, and keep an honest record of the work.
